business_problem: Wonderful was looking for a technology partner that could combine advanced multilingual models with globally distributed infrastructure, at a cost that scaled with their growth. They also needed strong reliability, trusted security, and excellent large-context performance. For this, they turned to Google Cloud . "Our journey with Google Cloud began with and Vertex AI ," Winkler says.
solution_summary: Wonderful uses Vertex AI to support model orchestration, while Gemini forms a crucial part of the solution's real-time voice pipeline, which stitches together multiple speech and reasoning models to produce human-like interactions across dozens of languages. A Zero Data Retention (ZDR) configuration ensures that all data processed is handled in-memory only. The company has expanded to a full Google Cloud deployment, leveraging Compute Engine Cloud Storage Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to manage its operations.
